connector.name: Pagewatch
connector.registryDescription: Read a URL as clean markdown, screenshot a website, url to PDF. Web access for agents, no signup.
connector.summary: Hosted at pagelens.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package pagewatch-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.pagelens, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PAGEWATCH_API_KEY
env.description: An existing key. Without one, the first call mints a free trial key and returns it.

env.name: PAGEWATCH_BASE_URL
env.description: Point at a different pagewatch deployment.
